red_flags: Only 13 Google reviews total and the vast majority have NO written text (just star ratings)
No independent verified platform (no klantenvertellen / Kiyoh page exists for this school)
Two of the captured quotes come from 1001rijscholen.nl, a low-trust affiliate/ReviewTycoon-generated review site
One 1-star Google rating from Maarten van Heerikhuize with no description, so the negative reason is unknown
CBR practical exam first-time pass rate is modest (~70%) with high retake volume

review_summary: The handful of written reviews are positive: students describe Bert as a clear-explaining, personable instructor whose pupils often pass first time, with home pick-up and an honest, no-upselling approach. However the evidence base is thin and low-trust: only ~13 Google reviews (3.8/5, mostly star-only with no text), no verified klantenvertellen page, two quotes from an affiliate review site, and one unexplained 1-star Google rating.
